title: File:Old Bagan, Myanmar, Landscape of ancient Bagan city.jpg
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
description: Bagan is an ancient city and the first kingdom that unified the regions that now constitute the country of Myanmar. From the 9th to 13th centuries, over 10000 Buddhist temples, pagodas and monasteries were constructed in the Bagan plains. Old Bagan, Pagan, Mandalay, Myanmar.
